title: OpenAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 新增了多个条目，包括 Decisions API 的 beta 发布说明（基于 gpt-6-luna）、API 使用层级简化（从五层到三层）以及 v1/decisions 端点，表明 OpenAI 推出了新的 API 产品并调整了开发者计划结构。

added_lines: Released the Decisions API in beta with gpt-6-luna. Turn text and images into typed answers 10x faster than the Responses API.

Simplified API usage tiers from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. Organizations automatically upgrade as total credit purchases reach tier minimums. See usage tiers for monthly usage limits and how to view rate limits for each model.
